create_PmtgInplaceWrapperEnv: create a PmtgInplaceWrapperEnv instance wrapping a gym environment with configurable trajectory generator parameters
reset_PmtgInplaceWrapperEnv: reset the PmtgInplaceWrapperEnv to initialize trajectory generators and set initial motor angles for laikago or minitaur robots
step_PmtgInplaceWrapperEnv: step the PmtgInplaceWrapperEnv with an action to compute trajectory generator outputs and return modified observations
modify_observation_PmtgInplaceWrapperEnv: modify an observation by appending cosine and sine of trajectory generator phases for the policy
configure_PmtgInplaceWrapperEnv_gin: configure the PmtgInplaceWrapperEnv class using gin to set frequency bounds, amplitudes, and stance lift cutoff values
